# Vector DSP

> Vector DSP LLC is a one-person audio software company in Colorado, founded by Kai Hansen in 2026. It builds professional audio plugins in C++ for music producers and mix engineers. Its product is ToneLab.

## ToneLab

ToneLab is a multi-effects audio plugin. It runs five effect lanes — reverb, distortion, delay, chorus and saturation — **in parallel**, and gives each lane its own EQ. That lets a producer confine any effect to a chosen frequency range: reverb on the mids only, distortion on the low end only, and so on, without smearing the rest of the mix.

The problem it replaces: doing this with conventional plugins requires building a send, a bus and an EQ instance for each effect — five buses and five EQs, rebuilt on every session. ToneLab makes that routing permanent inside a single insert.

- **Formats:** VST3, AU and AAX on macOS; VST3 and AAX on Windows. AAX builds are signed for Pro Tools.
- **Systems:** macOS 11+ (Universal — Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows 10 and 11.
- **Price:** one-time purchase. List price $73.99 USD; $54.99 USD during the Summer Sundown Sale with code SUNDOWN, through September 7, 2026. No subscription.
- **License:** one license activates up to 2 devices. Free updates throughout v1.x.
- **Free demo:** the installer ships with demo mode built in — the full plugin, no time limit, no account required. A license key unlocks it in place.
- **Current version:** 1.0
- **Note:** ToneLab by Vector DSP is a software plugin and is unrelated to hardware products of similar name from other manufacturers.
